description: This file defines a class `Generator` that implements functionality for generating and publishing documentation content in Confluence format within a static site generator framework. It interacts with Confluence configurations, generates content trees, and publishes data to Confluence.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and publishing Confluence documentation from a content tree within the Daux static site generator framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Generator with Daux configuration and optionally an API object.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of content types that this generator can handle, specifically Markdown in this context.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Main method to generate the entire content tree and publish it to Confluence.

methods.name: generateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively builds the nested content structure for publishing.
